client_alerts.headline: Gemini's new Workspace MCP connectors widen third-party data flow
client_alerts.body: Gemini now supports MCP integrations into Asana, Atlassian Rovo, HubSpot, Mailchimp, QuickBooks, Monday, and Salesforce, pulling data into Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Drive, and Chat without switching tabs. Any client on Google Workspace should confirm which of these connectors are actually enabled and whether that satisfies their data-residency / AI-data-risk policy — a concrete, current example to raise in advisory conversations.

top_moves.title: Mistral breaks its 16-day quiet streak with OCR, Agentic Search, and a refreshed model lineup
top_moves.body: Mistral OCR 4.1 went GA, a new Agentic Search retrieval layer landed for navigating and verifying complex documents with fewer turns and lower token use, and the general-purpose stack refreshed to Medium 3.5, Small 4, Large 3, and Ministral 3.

top_moves.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Facilitator now answers unaddressed meeting questions on its own
top_moves.body: Facilitator can run a Copilot web search and post the answer into meeting chat when a factual question goes unanswered, alongside new model-driven answer cards and a Cowork reasoning-effort slider (fast vs. deep).

top_moves.title: NIST closes the comment period on its AI-CSF quick-start guide (SP 1353)
top_moves.body: Public comments on NIST's Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 quick-start guide for using AI in CSF analysis and reporting closed Sept 16 — a revised or final version could land in the coming weeks, directly touching ISO 22301 / NIST SP 800-34 standards work.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: ChatGPT adds native Word support and ships Images 2.5 with faster, sketch-to-image generation
providers.detail: ChatGPT now drafts, summarizes, revises, and formats directly inside Microsoft Word (joining Excel/PowerPoint) on all plans including Free. Images 2.5 (Sept 8) cut generation latency roughly 50% and added a Sketch-to-image feature, plus two API variants — Flare for speed, Sunburst for detail. GPT-6 Astra remains in full GA across ChatGPT, API, Azure, and Bedrock.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: Claude Code ships a broad reliability, MCP, and telemetry pass; Admin API user-management exits beta
providers.detail: Beyond this week's Cowork/chat merge and new Docs/Slides tools, Claude Code shipped improvements across desktop, VS Code, web, Slack, and code review — clearer memory warnings, faster startup, better gateway handling, and fixes for sessions, plugins, and artifacts. The Enterprise Admin API's member/invite/group/custom-role endpoints are now GA.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: Gemini expands Workspace MCP integrations to Asana, Atlassian Rovo, HubSpot, Mailchimp, QuickBooks, Monday, and Salesforce
providers.detail: Users can pull data from these systems directly into Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Drive, and Chat. Also new: Gemini 3.8 Live / Live Extended Thinking (audio-to-audio) and Gemini 3.5 Transcribe for real-time captioning and voice agents, plus video extension and up to 4K video_config resolution.
providers.alertReason: New MCP connectors widen third-party data flow from client Workspace accounts — worth an explicit client conversation about which connectors are enabled.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: Grok 4.7 still not shipped — Sept 12 target missed, no benchmark card published
providers.detail: Musk's Sept 12 target for Grok 4.7 (reportedly 2.1T parameters, trained partly on SpaceX engineering data) has slipped; xAI's developer docs still list Grok 4.6 as newest with no model ID or pricing for 4.7. Grok Bot (enterprise autonomous workers) and Grok Build's terminal/tmux fixes continue rolling out.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: No new Llama/Muse Spark activity — seventh straight quiet day
providers.detail: Meta's most recent shipped model remains Muse Spark 1.3 (Sept 2, closed-weight, 1M-token context). Reporting continues to describe a shift away from open-weight Llama toward closed-source development, with no confirmed date for a successor.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: Mistral OCR 4.1 goes GA alongside a new Agentic Search layer and refreshed model lineup
providers.detail: Mistral shipped Mistral OCR 4.1 (GA), Agentic Search (a retrieval layer for navigating and verifying complex documents with fewer turns and lower token use), and refreshed its general-purpose stack to Mistral Medium 3.5, Small 4, Large 3, and Ministral 3. Note: Leanstral 1.5 (Lean 4 proof model) retires Sept 30.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: Perplexity lands on more Windows PCs via an HP preload and ships a local 'Portable Computer'
providers.detail: HP began preloading the Perplexity Windows app for sourced answers and local/connected-app work (Sept 15). Portable Computer for Windows (Sept 14) keeps sensitive work local and supports recurring tasks and long workflows without burning credits — useful for engagements where data can't leave the desktop.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: Teams' Facilitator now auto-answers unaddressed factual questions via web search
providers.detail: Requires Copilot Premium and manual per-meeting opt-in; designed to fire less than once per meeting. Also new: shareable individual chat responses, model-driven answer cards (weather/finance/news inline), a Cowork reasoning-effort slider (fast vs. deep), and translated meeting recaps rolling out.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: Copilot adds auto model-selection tiers (efficiency/balance/intelligence) across VS Code, CLI, and the Copilot app
providers.detail: Gives users more direct control over the cost/quality/speed tradeoff per task. Copilot CLI is at v1.0.83 (Sept 4). This follows this week's content-exclusion enforcement across agentic workflows and the Agent Merge public preview.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: No new release activity — 13th straight quiet day
providers.detail: Cursor has not shipped a public update since early September while Claude Code and GitHub Copilot both moved on model-selection and reliability features this week.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: Still no release — 89 days quiet since June 12
providers.detail: No new Gamma feature or model news found again today, the longest quiet streak of any tracked provider.

providers.name: Notion AI
providers.headline: Notion 3.7 adds a team-wide Agent Skills library and speeds up AI Search by 50%
providers.detail: Skills are reusable instructions (e.g. a standard monthly business review format) now shared workspace-wide (Sept 15). Builds on Sept 9's per-agent model controls, which let workspace owners restrict which models power Notion Agent vs. Custom Agents — useful for client compliance requirements.

persistent_signals.text: xAI — Grok 4.7 release delay — 2 weeks running (still targeting a date, still not shipped)

month_themes.then: No month-ago snapshot yet — history doesn't go back a full month.
month_themes.now: Frontier-model GA races (GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1, Gemini 3.8 line); enterprise AI-agent governance and compliance scrutiny (NIST SP 1353, Gartner's 40%-of-apps-embed-agents prediction); productivity suites converging on in-app docs/slides plus per-workspace model controls (Claude, Copilot, Notion).

habits.shift: Draft and revise runbooks directly in Claude's unified chat+Docs surface instead of round-tripping through a separate export step.
Track NIST SP 1353's post-comment-period revision (closed Sept 16) with a cited search tool before briefing clients on the 'final' CSF-for-AI guidance.
Run vendor deep-dives locally on Portable Computer when the material shouldn't leave the desktop, instead of a cloud-only Computer session.
Copilot and ChatGPT can now both draft/revise inside Word natively — pick whichever matches the client's own M365 tenant to avoid an export step.
Use Copilot's new inline answer cards for quick data pulls (finance/news/weather) while building exec decks instead of switching to a browser.
Use Gemini's audio-to-audio Live model for a spoken plan walkthrough that can reason mid-conversation, rather than a scripted TTS readout.

habits.task: Client advisory on AI data risk
habits.tool: Gemini Workspace MCP + Notion model controls
habits.shift: Flag the new Gemini Workspace MCP connectors (Salesforce, QuickBooks, etc.) and Notion's per-agent model controls to clients as concrete levers for their own AI-data-risk policy, not just theory.

community.signal: Discussion is dominated by Claude's Cowork+chat merge and new in-app Docs/Slides — mixed reaction between welcoming fewer surfaces and concern the minimal Cowork mode is going away.
community.so_what: Worth previewing before client-facing rollout of Claude Docs/Slides so you're not caught by a workflow change mid-engagement.

community.signal: Continued skepticism over Meta's silence on an open-weight Llama successor, contrasted with Meta's closed-weight Muse Spark line and reported delays to its next model.
community.so_what: If you rely on any open-weight fallback for air-gapped/DR environments, don't assume Meta keeps shipping one.

community.signal: Threads tracking GPT-6 Astra's full GA rollout across ChatGPT/API/Azure/Bedrock, plus early reaction to ChatGPT's new native Word support.
community.so_what: Native Word support is the more immediately useful item for proposal/SOW work than the Astra GA itself.

watch.title: NIST SP 1353 comment period closed
watch.body: Public comments on NIST's AI-CSF quick-start guide closed Sept 16, 2026; a revised or final version could land in the coming weeks — update standards-summary habits once it does.

watch.title: Grok 4.7 still MIA
watch.body: xAI's Sept 12 target has slipped with no model ID, pricing, or benchmark card yet; watch for an actual GA before recommending it for client work.

watch.title: Mistral retires Leanstral 1.5 on Sept 30
watch.body: Anyone using Mistral's Lean 4 formal-proof model should migrate before the Sept 30, 2026 retirement.

watch.title: Cursor's 13-day quiet streak
watch.body: No public Cursor release since early September while Claude Code and GitHub Copilot both shipped model-selection/reliability updates this week — watch for a competitive response.
